props.value:
# J.O.A.T. Executive Producer Bot

**Roadmap Stage #17**

**Live Execution Interface: READY**

**Studio Connectivity Diagnostics: READY**

Runs the J.O.A.T. production studio beneath the Main Assistant Bot. Possesses guru-level knowledge of subordinate departments and the production technology stack while respecting department authority.

props.name: markdown
props.value:
### Main Assistant â Executive Producer

This interface accepts a structured, authorized work order
from the J.O.A.T. Main Assistant Bot and returns a verified
Executive Producer execution result.

It does **not** claim downstream studio workers executed until
a separate, explicit, authorized dispatch interface exists.

props.label: Executive Producer Work Order
props.name: code
markdown
props.value:
### Safe Studio Connectivity Check

Discovers canonical Hugging Face Space repository IDs under
`Dezz-9-10` with `JOAT_SPECIALIST_TOKEN`, then inspects each
resolved Space's Gradio API.

This check does **not** run production jobs.

props.name: markdown
props.value:
### Stage 20 â Authenticated Department Dispatch

Only approved Master/Supervisor routes are available. Requests require an HMAC signature from the Main Assistant. `execute_live: false` is validation-only; live calls require `JOAT_DISPATCH_ENABLED=true`. Never paste the signing key into the UI.

props.label: Signed Dispatch Request (example requires valid signature)

### Acceptance Target

Original baseline: `65/65 PASS`

v1.2.0 additive target: `77/77 PASS`

`all_passed: true`

`production_ready: true`

character.responsibility: character identity, approved appearance, identity locks and character continuity

delivery_archive.responsibility: final-master protection, versioning, provenance, archiving and authorized delivery

director.responsibility: creative interpretation, performance intent, tone, staging and audience experience

editorial.responsibility: editorial assembly of QC-approved production assets

environment.responsibility: environment identity, locations, world assets, environment locks and visual-world continuity

generation_supervisor.responsibility: generation routing, engine selection, job creation and preservation of locked upstream instructions

generation_worker.responsibility: approved engine execution and generation-result creation without creative reinterpretation

performance_action.responsibility: performance beats, physical action, emotional continuity and shot-level action timing

quality_control.responsibility: independent inspection, pass/reject decisions, continuity verification and failure classification

shot_camera.responsibility: shot design, framing, camera position, movement, composition and cinematographic execution

sound.responsibility: sound execution while protecting dialogue, voice identity and creative intent

titles_graphics.responsibility: approved titles, credits, graphics and branding

voice_dialogue.responsibility: approved dialogue and voice execution, voice identity continuity, synchronization and audio handoff

props.name: markdown
props.value:
## J.O.A.T. Executive Producer Bot

**Version:** `1.2.11`

**Reports to:**  
J.O.A.T. Main Assistant Bot

**Live Execution Interface:** `READY`

**Downstream Production Execution:** `NOT CLAIMED`

### Command Chain

Dr. G  
â  
J.O.A.T. Main Assistant Bot  
â  
**J.O.A.T. Executive Producer Bot**  
â  
Studio Departments / Supervisors / Workers  
â  
J.O.A.T. Delivery/Archive Bot

### Critical Execution Boundary

The Executive Producer accepts the existing machine-callable
Main Assistant work-order contract and returns a verified
production-plan execution result.

Studio connectivity diagnostics are separate and safe. They
discover and inspect subordinate APIs but do not run production
jobs and do not prove downstream work execution.
